verdict.rationale: Square documents first-party webhooks: you can subscribe to event notifications, a 'Verify and Validate an Event Notification' guide covers checking signed deliveries, and the developer tooling includes webhook event logs. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic delivery retries or event replay/redelivery, which are core parts of this story. Missing for 10: automatic retry policy, event replay/redelivery, detail on the signature scheme, independent or hands-on corroboration.
